policy: Completed immutable continuation files are retained. An interrupted case without a completed file is rerun from its frozen source; no source or variant is regenerated.

events.limitation: The interrupted process may have issued an incomplete unjournaled target request for the next case. Only completed paired case files enter analysis.

events.cause: Poolside upstream HTTP 429 after the standard endpoint retry loop
events.limitation: No complete case file was produced. The frozen case is retried without changing its source, variant, provider route, or replicate label.

events.cause: Poolside upstream HTTP 429 after a 20-minute cooldown and the standard endpoint retry loop
events.limitation: No complete case file was produced. Subsequent resumes wait 30 minutes between upstream rate-limit failures.
